sloka: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे राम दीनो भ्रष्टाम्बरद्युतिः ।इन्द्रश्चिन्तापरीतात्मा ध्यानतत्परतां गतः ।। ७.३०.१९ ॥
transliteration: etasminnantare rāma dīno bhraṣṭāmbaradyutiḥ ।indraścintāparītātmā dhyānatatparatāṁ gataḥ ।। 7.30.19 ॥

translations.english: O Rama, in the meantime, Indra, distressed and having lost his celestial radiance, became absorbed in thought, his mind overwhelmed by worry.
